text:
Ada (Design): quick design review — proposing a compact streaming overlay that sits on top of the latest message when the model is generating. small token badge bottom-right, Stop / Regenerate inline, and a single-button access to Prompt Library. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (sketch)
Marco (Frontend): nice. can you call out expected DOM structure? overlay should be absolutely positioned inside the message container so it follows reflows.
Ada (Design): yep — idea is .msg__overlay with two rows: controls row and status row. controls: [Stop] [Regenerate] • prompt lib icon. status: token badge + latency small caption.
Sophia (PM): copy suggestion: keep button text short: `Stop` and `Retry` instead of `Regenerate` — less technical for product users. Also token badge tooltip: "tokens used (est.)" not "token count".
Jordan (A11y): big a11y nits: streaming overlay needs aria-live so screenreader knows new partial output arrived, and Stop/Retry must be keyboard focusable. Also token badge should not spam VO — use aria-hidden for live updates unless user expands.
Marco (Frontend): implementation note: live text arrives in chunks, we currently append into the message node. For screenreader we can maintain a visually-hidden `div[aria-live="polite"]` that only updates on finalization or user action. but product asked incremental readout — want a toggle?
Sophia (PM): incremental readout optional. default: no live readout to avoid noise. expose a setting in profile for "Voiceover streaming".
Jordan (A11y): agree — default off. keyboard shortcuts: `S` to Stop, `R` for Retry when focused in playground. must announce shortcut in tooltip and accessible label.
Marco (Frontend): CSS/JS example:
```
.msg__overlay { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 6px; display:flex; gap:8px; }
.token-badge { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.6); color: #fff; padding:4px 6px; border-radius:10px; }
```
Kai (Infra): watch perf on continuous token counting — we don't want to hit the token-meter backend every chunk. front-end should estimate locally and throttle updates (e.g., once per 300ms or on chunk boundaries).
Ada (Design): visual tweak: when streaming, show a subtle pulse on the token badge. when paused, badge dims and shows final count. also show a small progress bar at top of overlay if request exceeds 2s.
Marco (Frontend): will implement token badge with debounced update + `aria-live="off"` by default. when user opens the token popover we will set `aria-live="polite"` and expose full transcript.
Sophia (PM): copy for token tooltip: "Estimated tokens consumed so far. Final count may differ." small and clear.
Jordan (A11y): ensure all actionable icons have `aria-label` and visible focus ring. for screenreader preview provide a single summary line: "Generating response — X tokens used (estimated)".
Ada (Design): small UX question: where to put prompt library access? inside overlay or main toolbar? preference to keep overlay minimal: add a tiny prompt icon that opens the prompt drawer anchored to the message.
Marco (Frontend): prefer main toolbar for discoverability, but overlay icon OK as a quick-action. I'll prototype overlay icon that mirrors main toolbar handler.
ops-bot: Deploy preview available: https://deploy.preview/redwood/playground/stream-overlay/1842009876
Kai (Infra): testing note: confirm overlay works in compact conversation mode (collapsed avatars) and in narrow screens. it should not obscure essential message text.
Ada (Design): accessibility checklist for handoff:
- aria-live behavior documented
- keyboard shortcuts and tooltip copy
- token badge visual states (streaming/paused/final)
- focus management when opening prompt drawer
- small motion preference respects `prefers-reduced-motion`

Marco (Frontend): I'll PR a11y-first prototype tomorrow. ping @Jordan for quick review. keeping copy changes from @Sophia inlined.
Jordan (A11y): will review. quick note: for VoiceOver on mac, using aria-live polite might still be noisy; test with a reduced frequency update strategy and final announcement on completion.
Sophia (PM): thanks team. final ask: update docs and release notes mentioning the new `Stop`/`Retry` labels and the profile toggle for voiceover streaming.
Ada (Design): updated figma with keyboard states + motion off: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz/updated — will attach to PR.
Marco (Frontend): got it. starting prototype. :rocket:
Jordan (A11y): thanks — will add to a11y checklist for the release.
ops-bot: Note: thread closed after deploy preview posted."
